definition: to show a story or feeling by acting
description: On the small stage of a basement theatre with brick walls and string lights, a young woman in a black polo neck and trousers sits on a wooden chair and leans far back with wide eyes and flying hair, as if caught in a storm. A man holds an electric fan towards her and a woman on a ladder pours water from a watering can, while a man plays an upright piano. She then sits up and shades her eyes with one hand, looking into the distance. The audience in the front rows laughs and covers their faces.

de.answer: Sie stellt auf der Bühne einen Sturm dar.
de.question: Was macht die Schauspielerin?

es.answer: Está representando una tormenta en el escenario.
